key_provisions_or_claims: BVLOS operations categorised into Low, Medium and High risk, each with tiered Basic and Level 1-3 requirements.
Operators need a UA Operator Permit and Class 1 Activity Permit from CAAS.
Applicants must submit system safety assessments (FHA, FMECA, FTA), an operations manual and a compliance checklist.
Catastrophic failure probability must not exceed 1x10-6 per flight hour for medium risk and 1x10-7 for high risk.
Detect-and-avoid, command-and-control link, software assurance and emergency recovery requirements scale with risk, up to no human intervention for high risk.
named_instruments_referenced: Singapore Air Navigation (101 – Unmanned Aircraft Operations) Regulations 2019
annotation.summary_en: Singapore CAAS Advisory Circular setting out its risk-based assessment methodology for beyond visual line-of-sight drone operations. It sorts operations into low, medium and high risk, with tiered technical and operational requirements. It also covers permit applications and safety-assessment evidence.
